preservation.privateDLSS: clean, remote-free; SDKs and preserved snapshots present

method: Original Nogova R01WarCry.Noe, Malden01TakeTheCar.ABEL and Everon05HeavyMetal.Eden. Copied profiles, --nosound, Windows Vulkan synchronization validation at1920x1080/TAA100%,auto materials/one-bounce GI/RT sunlight+cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off. Matched native PBR Off/auto-GI Off/auto-GI On at09:00/17:30, independent CPU controls and verified restoration, advancing-simulation developer-camera translation/turns and grounded retreats. Not physical traversal, Steam-route acceptance or mission completion.
costMethod: RTX4060Ti/NVIDIA617.14; normal route scene workloads, warm10s; GI Off/On/On/Off, settle4s/sample6s, paired interval medians. No build/tests/census during sampling. Actual target lighting may be captured CPU while hardware T&L remains enabled. Costs are whole scene workloads including scenery and ordinary variation; forced-CPU route not separately timed.
limits: Source assessment does not certify full-model PBR/GI coverage. Alternative LOD prerequisites are mutually exclusive, not simultaneous triangles or visible-coverage percentages. Half-resolution family samples include scenery; bounded eligible probe identities establish separate reflector participation. Original authored lighting, opacity, geometry, captured ambient and sampler gates remain. Occluded first shrine and blocked close cameras are retained as exploratory evidence, not clear target acceptance.
reflectorTrial: The16 finally rejected regions also failed with reception=false; large PBR-on/GI-off raster boundaries persist. The same trial also changed668..671/678: matched controls distinguish their existing pattern from the16 failures.668..671 keep reception;678 retains ambient in final.

appearance.basis: Matched original-gameplay PBR Off, auto/GI Off and auto/GI On controls at daylight and dusk, independent CPU controls, four retained matched motion sheets, and grounded retreat captures; final bytes DB03FA0E9445C457E87406F4194ADD1ADC5405CBD8A8C94E542F380E927A7B53.
appearance.kostel: Accepted blank plaster walls retain coherent whole-face finish and photographed detail at day/dusk. Large front, side and bell-jamb trial wedges are absent after withdrawing642..644,646..650,653..659. Original window/door/cornice lighting stays intact. The dark roof cap has a modest warm rough-dielectric response and keeps ambient; existing tiled-roof reception is not new Batch35 coverage.
appearance.kostel3: Upper repeated-window plaster band665 creates a new diagonal brightness strip already with GI off, including reception=false, and is withdrawn. Retained tower jambs, gable and small trim do not reproduce that gross failure in the tested controls. Clock, hands, shutters, glazing and door remain original. Existing sun-shadow/gable patterns are retained, not diagnosed as newly introduced geometry faults.
appearance.kostelik: Original front lattice, photographed windows, portal architecture and baked wall shadow remain intact. Close CPU wall controls show modest coherent reception without the rejected Nogova raster blocks. Some near mineral candidates remain sampler-gated, and several distant source qualifications have no isolated visible-adoption proof.
appearance.kapl: Unobstructed original placement122207 separates shrine base/side participation from surroundings. The rear triangular pattern is present in PBR Off and baseline and is not a new raster defect. Region678 stays reflector-only to preserve ambient;679/680 enable base/side reception. Devotional niche, flowers, painted columns, letters and ornamental pediment remain original.
appearance.motion: Reviewed retained start/middle/end day/dusk comparisons for church side, full clock tower, shrine back and chapel rear wing. No new gross material-boundary or brightness discontinuity is observed in these bounded advancing-simulation translations/turns. Not a continuous-video ghosting qualification or proof of every LOD transition.
appearance.excluded: First rock-obstructed shrine placement53732, tree-obstructed back/town/close scouts, foliage-filled portal-bound view and one exploratory enhanced-mode candidate retreat are not clear target acceptance. Counters for surrounding terrain, old roofs, bark and cemetery stone are not credited as new target reception. UI differences between independent mission runs are not material changes.
appearance.limit: Source assessment and complete-face prerequisite qualification do not certify full-model PBR coverage, every instance, all lighting conditions or source-specific visible percentages. No renderer, source, UV, normal, geometry, shadow, alpha or lighting-gate repair is attempted.
